title: Pension schemes newsletter 185 — September 2026
text:
This newsletter is published by HMRC’s Pension Schemes Services to update stakeholders on the latest news for pension schemes.

 Pension schemes newsletter 185 has articles on:

 • pension scheme return — wound up schemes

 • lump sum death benefits process

 • closure of pension schemes online service — action needed to migrate pension schemes

 • relief at source
